purpose: Trigger-boundary regression set for ugt-nextjs-auth-setup. S* queries must route here (login methods, RBAC/permissions, documented auth symptoms); N* must NOT (DB plumbing → database-setup, page theming → design-setup, CI → cicd-setup).
method: 3 independent judges, randomized order, full skill listing incl. superpowers distractors
